title: Isiguli
intro: Kudala, ezinsukwini zokuqala zomlando wesintu, imiphefumulo emibili yayimi phambi koMdali wayo neminikelo. Omunye wamukelwa, omunye wangamukelwa. Okwalandela kwaba yinhlekelele yokuqala enkulu phakathi kwezelamani - isenzo esisodwa sokuzibamba ngesineke kanye nesenzo esisodwa sokuziphindiselela okubuhlungu. Ungangithola ukuthi ngingubani?
clues: Ngazalwa ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuphila komuntu emhlabeni
Ngangingumntwana wabantu ababili bokuqala ukuhamba kulo mhlaba
Ngake nganikela umhlatshelo ovela kokuhle kakhulu emhlambini wami ukuze ngijabulise uMdali wami
Umnikelo wami wamukelwa uvela phezulu, kanti umnikelo womfowethu wenqatshwa
Lapho ngisongelwa ngokufa, ngakhetha ukungaphakamisi isandla sami ngokumelene nomfowethu noma udadewethu
Ngaba ngumuntu wokuqala emlandweni wesintu ukubulawa ngokungemthetho ngomunye umuntu

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Waba yisisulu sokuqala sokubulawa emlandweni wesintu
Wasinda esikhukhuleni esikhulu ngaphakathi komkhumbi wokhuni
Wazulazula iminyaka engamashumi amane ehlane elikhulu
outcome.answer: Waba yisisulu sokuqala sokubulawa emlandweni wesintu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
